note: Check Input maps controlled gap terms to related Patterns. Useful Lenses are derived through the Pattern -> Lens matrix. Issues are not used as Check Input Step 2 targets.

primary.title: Missing Authority
primary.summary: A structural condition where a region, action, state, or decision path exists without a declared governing authority.

primary.title: Incomplete Declaration
primary.summary: A structural condition where an element is declared but required attributes, dependencies, or linked definitions are missing.

secondary.title: Authority Collision
secondary.summary: A structural condition where multiple authorities claim governance over the same region without a declared precedence or resolution rule.

useful_lenses.title: Absence Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Detects structurally required elements that are missing from the observed structure.

useful_lenses.title: Authority Overlay Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Maps declared authority hierarchies onto observed structure to detect absence, override, or conflict.

useful_lenses.title: Conflict Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Detects mutually incompatible constraints, claims, states, or declarations that cannot be simultaneously satisfied.

useful_lenses.title: Constraint Sufficiency Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Evaluates whether declared constraints are sufficient to eliminate structural degrees of freedom.

useful_lenses.title: Interface Contract Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Compares declared interface structure to observed runtime structure to detect contract deviations.

useful_lenses.title: Invariant Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Verifies that declared invariants are structurally enforceable and not contradicted by observed structure.

useful_lenses.title: Reconciliation Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Evaluates whether structural changes align with declared authority updates, version changes, or reconciliation rules.

results.caveat: These are related structural references, not a final diagnosis.

primary.title: Overreach
primary.summary: A structural condition where actions, effects, authority, or modifications extend beyond declared scope without authorization.

secondary.title: Boundary Leakage
secondary.summary: A structural condition where effects, permissions, state, data, or authority cross a declared boundary without an authorized exception.

secondary.title: Unconstrained Expansion
secondary.summary: A structural condition where a region, process, authority, or effect expands without governing constraints limiting growth.

useful_lenses.title: Boundary Compliance Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Evaluates observed structure against declared boundary posture, including allow, block, and exception rules.

useful_lenses.title: Compression Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Reduces structural graphs into stable minimal representations for comparison, redundancy detection, and diffing.

useful_lenses.title: Constraint Sufficiency Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Evaluates whether declared constraints are sufficient to eliminate structural degrees of freedom.

useful_lenses.title: Escalation Gradient Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Measures structural growth or intensification across sequential executions, states, or transitions.

useful_lenses.title: Isolation Boundary Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Evaluates whether structural constraints, effects, and regions remain contained within declared boundaries.

useful_lenses.title: Overreach Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Detects structure that exceeds declared scope or authority reach.

useful_lenses.title: Propagation Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Traces how structural declarations, effects, or state changes propagate across boundaries or stages.

useful_lenses.title: Variance / Entropy Lens
useful_lenses.summary: Measures structural variability across repeated or comparable evaluations and identifies divergence beyond expected bounds.

results.caveat: These are related structural references, not a final diagnosis.
